name: KCM Cable and Manufacturing
old_description: KCM Cable & Manufacturing is a fantastic resource for any company seeking custom cable production. KCM provides valuable insight for cable optimization and DFM with their experience and feedback. They produce high-quality custom cables, are prompt to respond with quotes and scheduling, and will be a significant asset for any company at any phase of the cable manufacturing process. I highly recommend working with KCM Cable & Manufacturing.
about:
KCM Cable & Manufacturing operates from Tooele, Utah, about forty minutes west of Salt Lake City. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces wire harnesses and cable assemblies covering power, signal, coaxial, and RF configurations across a wide range of connector families — from military-spec circulars (MIL-DTL-38999, 5015, 26482) to industrial, board-level, and automotive connectors. Work flows from prototype and first-article builds through repeat production, with in-house cutting, crimping, shield termination, routing, testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 classes, and documentation. Facility size and headcount are not published.

Customers span aerospace and defense, space and satellite, robotics and autonomy, medical devices, semiconductor and test equipment, data center and power infrastructure, industrial and energy, agriculture and heavy equipment, marine and subsea, mining, and automotive aftermarket. The company also accepts inquiries from any sector that requires wired interconnects.

KCM emphasizes hands-on manufacturing paired with organized processes and clear communication, aiming to make complex cable work easier to understand, quote, and build. It offers design input at the quote stage, accepts customer-supplied or consigned material, and welcomes facility visits.
